svg.aria-label: Direction predictor, path history, tables and recovery
svg.text: Direction predictor, path history, tables and recovery
What is measured is the history update rule and the table layout; the provider logic is standard TAGE; the recovery mechanism is a conjecture.
Six tagged tables, indexed by PC and history
layout measured; lengths and widths are ours
shifted left one place per taken branch
not taken branches leave the history still ●
two paths that differ there share one history ○
only the PC index tells them apart ○
probe to add: mispredict once per N taken branches +
rebuild cost grows with N under rewind, flat under copies +
index: PC 18:2 XOR a fold of the history ●
PC bit 6 splits the block: two branches per lookup ●
own associativity per table ●, 3 bit counters ◆
no privilege or process tag on an entry ●
says where the last calls went
one site, many targets, told apart
no ASID or EL on an entry
fetch moves to it at once
the same path history indexes direction and indirect tables ●
a wrong path indirect is corrected without waiting for older branches ●
